long_biography.plain_text:
An early plastic-bag manufacturing venture gave Alisher Usmanov his first business fortune before metals became the centre of his holdings. He moved through finance and investment, then used acquisitions to assemble the mining and metallurgical group that became Metalloinvest. The resulting company joined iron-ore production and steelmaking within one industrial platform.

Fencing supplied a separate, enduring commitment. After competing in the sport, Usmanov served for years in national, European and international administration and established programmes to support its development. His Art, Science and Sport foundation broadened that institutional work across culture, education and science, funding initiatives in each field.
